verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires the tagline to render correctly and specifies portable font handling for the PDF export.
First concrete failure: the exported tagline displayed as garbled text instead of the intended words.
The generic statement that it is fixed contains no target-specific proposition; supporting context supplies essentially all alignment to the tagline-rendering issue.
The source does not identify the exported-text problem, and intervening discussion of D2D and cover specifications makes the generic reference insufficiently target-specific.
